findings.title: Parsed initial cache is not bound to the retained HTML
findings.impact: A stale or changed page_000.json can suppress the first continuation while the genuine HTML receipt still validates, yielding false exhaustion. No such mismatch exists in the two actual fresh snapshots.
findings.counterexample: Original HTML has one video and a continuation; cached page_000.json omits the continuation. The unchanged raw HTML checksum and requested URL pass, and baseline reports exhausted_count_unknown with one video.
findings.repair: Re-extract ytInitialData from the retained checksum-verified HTML and reject any unequal parsed cache before selecting a grid.
findings.observer: R10-01 in observe_fresh_integrity.py must change from false exhaustion to an explicit initial-cache mismatch error. All 118 retained pages must still pass.

findings.title: Requested surface is not checked against the selected tab endpoint
findings.impact: A self-consistent official-channel Videos response can be labelled and completed as the Live surface. The two retained snapshots have correct selected endpoints.
findings.counterexample: Request streams but provide a selected Videos tab at /@jepcolombia/videos, with the correct official channel ID and valid primary grid. Baseline emits channel_streams with selected_tab_title Videos and pagination_exhausted true.
findings.repair: Before consuming the grid, validate the observed selected-tab endpoint against the requested surface and official handle or canonical channel path. Preserve the observed endpoint and title as provenance.
findings.observer: R10-02 must become an explicit surface mismatch error; valid Videos and Live snapshots continue to parse.
